title: Hamming distance as the size of the support
statement:
Let $u,v$ be words of length $n$ over a finite alphabet $\alpha$, that is, functions $\mathrm{Fin}\,n \to \alpha$. Then the Hamming distance between them equals the number of coordinates on which they differ:
\[
d(u,v) = \abs{\{i \in \mathrm{Fin}\,n : u_i \ne v_i\}}.
\]
hypotheses_covered: u and v are words of length n over a finite alphabet
replaced:
For any two words $u,v$, the Hamming distance equals the cardinality of their support:
$\mathrm{hammingDist}(u,v) = |\mathrm{support}(u,v)|$.
